description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elemental dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marath.
Repeat.

uses.name: Marath, Will of the Wild
uses.cardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it
